## Où j'en suis
We picked up PR #405 (HubSpot webhooks) and found it couldn't be finished: subscription management rejects our private-app token, so we moved to polling the CRM search API every 15 min, with windowed paging past the 10k result cap and a filter keeping only companies with ARR > 0. That work went into PR #409 with auto-merge enabled, but the PR is still open: the e2e check `test_admin_accounts.py::test_accounts_table_shows_owner` fails, so auto-merge never fired.

- [en-cours] e2e fixture still has a trial company with an owner, which the new `arr > 0` filter skips (3 rows expected, 2 got)
- [prochaine-étape] fix that fixture, then let auto-merge land #409; Noa adds `HUBSPOT_TOKEN` to Secrets Manager for staging/prod
- [essai-raté] registering webhook subscriptions via API returned 401 — private app tokens can't manage them, only public apps can
- [décision] switch to polling every 15 min and close #405 with a comment (source: t04)
- [décision] sync only companies with ARR > 0, skip trials entirely (source: t10)
- [décision] open the PR with auto-merge, and have Noa put the token in Secrets Manager (source: t12)
